title: Stuck 'Paste ⋯' box appears unasked at the top-left of the Maestro window and cannot be closed
seam: web-engine start-up options: src-tauri/tauri.conf.json, src/lib/issueMapWindow.ts, src/lib/workJournalWindow.ts
story: Sometimes a small white 'Paste ⋯' box sat on top of the tabs at the top-left of Maestro and could not be clicked or closed. After this change Maestro tells its web engine not to show that touch-text menu, on the main window and on the issue map and Work Journal pop-out windows. Right-click menus and Ctrl+V paste work as before.

checks.criterion: The touch-text 'Paste ⋯' box no longer appears stuck at the top-left of the window
checks.steps: Install the update. Use Maestro on Windows as usual for a day: terminals, text boxes, touchpad taps and long presses.
checks.expected: No white 'Paste ⋯' box over the tab bar.

checks.criterion: The issue map window and the Work Journal pop-out still open
checks.steps: Start Maestro fresh, open a git project and press Alt+M. Then open the Work Journal panel and choose Pop out in its page actions menu.
checks.expected: Both windows open and show their content, with no error.

checks.criterion: Right-click menus and Ctrl+V still work
checks.steps: Right-click in a text box, then press Ctrl+V in a text box after copying some made-up text.
checks.expected: The normal right-click menu appears, and the text is pasted.
